arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse
# Test various alignment scenarios
tests = [
    '{:>10}',      # right align with width
    '{:<10}',      # left align with width  
    '{:^10}',      # center align with width
    '{:>}',        # right align without width (edge case)
    '{:0>10d}',    # right align with zero fill for number
]
for fmt in tests:
    try:
        p = parse.Parser(fmt)
        print(f'{fmt!r} -> regex: {p._expression}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{fmt!r} -> Error: {e}')
"
